title: Burned memo / Project Aquarius references Zodiac

tellings.quote: the uh burned memo or the project Aquarius, one of them, I can't remember which, actually makes reference to project zodiac

plain: One of two documents said to come from inside the US government, a so-called burned memo or a Project Aquarius paper, mentions a Project Zodiac, according to an online researcher who goes by UAPGerb. He says he cannot remember which of the two it is, and ties the matter to a man named Lee Graham. If true, it would link these secret UFO programmes to one another.
